final: WITH t AS (SELECT te.team_id AS team_id, AVG(CAST(mh.w AS REAL)/mh.g) AS avg_wr, COUNT(mh.team_id) AS cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team) te LEFT JOIN manager_half mh ON mh.team_id = te.team_id GROUP BY te.team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wr) AS mean_wr FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wr, t.cnt, t.avg_wr - m.mean_wr AS diff FROM t, m WHERE m.mean_wr IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
